sensor: OPT101P, intended circuit at 3.3 V; output GP26
method: Same 16-window slow LED-state test after repositioning sensor toward the onboard LED. 50 ms settling, 256 ADC reads per input per window.
result: Strong repeatable light response confirms functional sensor-to-ADC path.
limits: This verifies functional light detection, not a visual inspection of every wire or the decoupling capacitor.
Sampling is software paced; no edge-response, absolute timing or VRR claim.
No ADC-rail hits were observed; amplifier linearity and headroom remain to be characterized.
GP27 is an auxiliary unconnected input with coupling, not a second functional optical channel.
Voltage estimates use nominal 3.3 V ADC reference.
